items.reasons: Essentially a flat front elevation: the top board is only a thin 1-2 row trim with ornament, and there's no lit top plane like mci-cooler has. The bottle rows are a noisy jumble of multicolour single pixels and bright sticker-like highlights on dark brown.

Pure front elevation: the 3x3 grid of bottle cubbies faces straight out with almost no top plane. Its saturated red/green bottle-end blobs and flat ochre frame don't match the originals' shading steps, and at 1x it reads as a patterned box.

A green chain-link panel drawn flat-on between two blue posts, with green bars top and bottom. It has no 3/4 depth and doesn't read as a fence run; in the room it looks like a rug or crate. The mesh diamonds make a noisy busy pattern at 1x.

For a walk-in stair hut the door is tiny, about 6x14px at 1x, so the hut is a scale too small and reads like a cabinet. The bright green sign above the door is a sticker-like highlight, and the roof slab looks pasted on with a hard dark outline and a gap over the front face.

The vertical teal streaks on the left of the grey tank body look like stray sticker pixels. The tank uses an almost monochrome light-grey ramp with soft dithering, unlike the crisp flat shading steps of the originals, and the X-braced stand is drawn as a flat front elevation.

The locker is a flat front elevation with no top plane. The broom/mop and red bucket stick out beyond the locker's footprint and are cramped against the canvas edge, and at 1x the thin sliver doesn't read as a cleaning locker.
